environment.execution: isolated development environment, not user Windows repository

notes: Successful third-source tie-breaking remains WATCH rather than silently becoming PASS.
Fixture identity and required-market identity disputes are quarantined rather than majority-voted.
Score and event-state disputes cannot be overridden by a source-of-truth rule in V22.
The isolated suite count must not be represented as the user repository count until a consolidated installer is verified on the user machine.
scope: Cross-Provider Disagreement Resolution, Quarantine & Source-of-Truth Governance
